market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. AI selloff and 5% yield create headwinds for equities. Fed week (rate decision) is critical catalyst. Oil volatility adds noise. Expect S&P 500 to test support; software and energy outperform. Nikkei and EM remain under pressure. 2-3 week consolidation likely before direction clarifies.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI slowdown is cyclical, not secular. 5% yields normalize over 6-12 months as inflation cools. Energy transition and HBM demand remain structural. Software and AI applications benefit from eventual capex resumption. Key risk: if energy crisis persists, stagflation scenario emerges.
